# TotalEnergies Marks a Milestone on Wall Street


On September 28, 2026, TotalEnergies Chairman and CEO **Patrick Pouyanné** rang the Closing Bell at the


[New York Stock Exchange (NYSE)](https://www.nyse.com/index) , concluding a day dedicated to engaging with shareholders, investors, and analysts during the Company’s annual Strategy & Outlook presentation at our Investor Day in New York City.


The occasion highlighted a relationship that has continued to grow over decades: TotalEnergies’ longstanding connection to U.S. capital markets and the important role U.S. investors play in the Company’s future.


## 35 Years on the NYSE


TotalEnergies has been listed on the New York Stock Exchange since 1991, reflecting decades of engagement with U.S. investors and one of the world's deepest capital markets. In December 2025, TotalEnergies converted its NYSE ADRs into ordinary shares.


### Did you know?


Nearly half of our institutional shareholders are U.S.-based. A direct NYSE listing gives investors easier access to the same shares traded in Paris, with extended trading hours.


### Investor Day: Sharing Our Strategy and Outlook


Investor Day provided an opportunity for TotalEnergies' leadership team to present the Company's strategy, outlook and priorities for long-term value creation.


As a leading integrated multi-energy company, TotalEnergies continues to build on the strengths of its diversified portfolio across oil and gas, LNG, integrated power and low-carbon energies while maintaining a disciplined approach to growth, profitability and shareholder returns.


## A Long-Term Commitment to the United States


The United States is a key market for TotalEnergies and an important contributor to the Company's growth strategy.


For TotalEnergies, ringing the Closing Bell highlighted our strong presence in the United States, where our Company continues to invest across a broad portfolio of energy activities, including[oil and gas](https://corporate.totalenergies.us/oil-and-gas) ,[liquefied natural gas (LNG)](https://corporate.totalenergies.us/totalenergies-largest-exporter-us-liquefied-natural-gas-lng) ,[renewable electricity and low-carbon](https://corporate.totalenergies.us/low-carbon-electricity) energy solutions.


The ceremony concluded the trading day at the NYSE and capped a day dedicated to sharing TotalEnergies' vision for the future with the global investment community.
